recent_posts.title: The AI Agent Identity Problem: Why Governance Is the Missing Layer in Enterprise AI
recent_posts.summary: As AI agents move from demos into production, enterprises face a critical governance gap: agents lack verifiable identities, defined scopes, and persistent audit trails. Without agent identity, compliance teams cannot answer who authorized an action, what data was accessed, or whether outputs stayed within approved boundaries. The post outlines four architectural principles to address this: defining identity and permissions at creation (not runtime), applying governance to derived outputs not just source data, maintaining lifecycle records that outlast short-lived agents, and using human oversight as a periodic audit function rather than constant supervision. Snowflake's own internal Go-To-Market AI Assistant, serving 6,000+ employees and handling 35,000+ questions per week, is cited as a case study where role-based access, certified queries, and scoped permissions were built in as design constraints from the start.

recent_posts.title: OpenAI GPT 5.5 on Snowflake Cortex AI
recent_posts.summary: OpenAI GPT-5.5 is now available in private preview on Snowflake Cortex AI, with Snowflake serving as a launch partner for same-day availability. The model can be accessed through Cortex Code, Snowflake Intelligence, Cortex AI Functions (via SQL's AI_COMPLETE), and the Cortex REST API. Key capabilities include improved agentic coding, complex multi-step task execution, structured and unstructured data analysis, and enterprise AI agent development — all within Snowflake's secure, governed perimeter. Developers can integrate using the OpenAI SDK pointed at the Cortex REST API endpoint.

recent_posts.title: Cloud Migration Services with Snowflake LiftOff
recent_posts.summary: Snowflake has launched LiftOff, a partner-focused program designed to reduce the complexity and risk of migrating to the Snowflake AI Data Cloud. The program provides a unified delivery model combining partner expertise with Snowflake best practices, aiming to deliver production-ready outcomes including a secure landing zone, migration timelines, architectural documentation, governance plans, converted code samples, and a clear path to full-scale implementation.

recent_posts.title: Cortex Agents: The Platform Powering Snowflake Intelligence and Enterprise AI Agents
recent_posts.summary: Snowflake has announced Cortex Agents, a platform for building, governing, and scaling enterprise AI agents. Key capabilities include MCP connectors for integrating with external tools like Jira, Salesforce, GitHub, and Slack; agent skills for reusable modular task packages; a sandboxed Python code execution environment; multi-tenancy with row-level data isolation; agent versioning with commit-based lifecycle management and instant rollback; resource budgets for granular cost control at agent and team levels; and Cortex Agent Evaluations using the GPA (Goal-Plan-Action) framework to measure tool selection accuracy, answer correctness, and logical consistency. The platform is designed to move AI agents from prototyping to production within Snowflake's existing security and governance perimeter.

recent_posts.title: Cortex Code Expands: One Governed Agent for Your Entire Data Stack, Everywhere You Work
recent_posts.summary: Snowflake has expanded Cortex Code, its AI coding agent, to support a broader data stack including AWS Glue, Databricks, and Postgres alongside existing dbt and Apache Airflow support. New agent skills cover Snowpark Python pipelines, Spark-to-Snowflake migration, dbt project management, and DCM lifecycle management. The platform now offers a VS Code extension, MCP server, Claude Code plugin, and Agent Client Protocol (ACP) support for 30+ editors. Snowsight users gain Cloud Agents for long-running background tasks, Plan Mode for reviewing agent actions before execution, and Snap & Ask for querying on-screen data visuals. An Agent SDK enables embedding Cortex Code in custom Python and TypeScript workflows.

recent_posts.title: Announcing Claude Opus 4.7 on Snowflake Cortex AI
recent_posts.summary: Claude Opus 4.7, Anthropic's latest model, is now available in public preview on Snowflake Cortex AI in the U.S. and EU. The model brings improved agentic capabilities, better instruction following, multi-step reasoning, enhanced vision for higher-resolution images, and adjustable effort levels for balancing performance and latency. It integrates with Cortex Code, Cortex AI Functions, Cortex REST API, and Snowflake Intelligence, enabling enterprise use cases like AI-assisted coding, natural language data analysis via SQL, and building agentic applications within Snowflake's security and governance perimeter.

recent_posts.title: Snowflake Intelligence: From Answers to Action with Your Personal Work Agent
recent_posts.summary: Snowflake Intelligence is a personalized work agent for business users that connects governed enterprise data with action across tools like Gmail, Slack, Jira, and Salesforce via MCP connectors. New capabilities include an iOS mobile app (public preview), Deep Research for multi-agent cross-source analysis, reusable Skills and Artifacts for workflow automation, Agent Versioning with CI/CD support, and identity provider integration via Okta and Microsoft Entra ID. The platform runs on Snowflake's existing governance model with role-based access, row-level policies, and full auditability, enabling enterprises to move from AI experimentation to production deployment.

recent_posts.title: dbt Projects on Snowflake: Build & Deploy with Cortex Code
recent_posts.summary: Cortex Code is Snowflake's AI coding agent built specifically for the Snowflake and dbt ecosystem. It enables data engineers to generate dbt models, update YAML documentation, write tests, and optimize SQL performance from a single prompt or CLI command. Key capabilities include context-aware model generation using dbt conventions (config and ref macros), simultaneous YAML and test updates when editing models, smart troubleshooting for Snowflake-specific SQL, and performance analysis via run_results.json. It supports dbt Core, dbt Platform, and native Snowflake dbt projects, accessible through both the Snowsight UI and a CLI tool.

recent_posts.title: Snowflake Appoints Mayank Upadhyay as Chief Security & Trust Officer
recent_posts.summary: Snowflake has appointed Mayank Upadhyay as its new Chief Security & Trust Officer. Upadhyay brings over two decades of experience at Google, where he contributed to foundational security technologies including BeyondCorp (zero-trust architecture), multi-factor authentication rollout, and passkeys. In his new role, he will unify Snowflake's corporate and product security under a single strategy, with a focus on AI-native controls to help enterprises safely adopt agentic AI.

recent_posts.title: Six startups building AI data apps on Snowflake to watch in 2026
recent_posts.summary: Six global startups are highlighted as 'ones to watch' from the 2026 Snowflake Startup Challenge. Each is building data-driven AI applications on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud: AAAxAgents (enterprise AI agents for KPI dashboards), ContexQ (financial crime intelligence using graph AI), Holoplan (VR/MR project management with 3D digital twins), Hypercube (renewable energy asset management), Tynapse (auditable AI agent trust layer for regulated industries), and Unified Honey (business-process-first data modeling). All leverage Snowflake tools like Cortex Search, Snowpark, and Cortex AI to power their platforms.
